status: Specified after read-only distribution/feature diagnosis and before experimental model fitting
population: Preserve all 205 laps. Experiments exclusively use the original 103 training plus 66 validation laps: 169 laps in 40 recording blocks. The original 36 test laps in 11 blocks are already-observed historical evidence, never experimental fitting, feature diagnostics, preprocessing, weighting, scoring or selection input.
folds: Five seeded recording-block folds: sort original development block IDs, permute with NumPy default_rng(42), assign permuted index modulo 5. Save assignments before fitting. All five prefixes of every lap and every lap of a block stay together. Preserve any existing duplicate/capture links embodied in v071 blocks. Unknown physical links remain a limitation; no invented driver identities.
target: Untransformed verified final lap time in seconds. No historical-median subtraction/addition, target-normalized progress or final-distance normalization.
F0: Unchanged v071 13-feature implementation and RBF SVR C=10, epsilon=0.5, default gamma=scale; training-only median imputer and standard scaler.
F1: F0 plus seven trailing-five-second features: mean/std/delta speed (km/h), mean/max observed positive deceleration (m/s^2), brake-on time fraction (>=5%), mean throttle (%). Time weights clip observed forward left-hold intervals to [checkpoint-5, last observed timestamp]; backward adjacent speed differences use actual positive dt. Never centered windows or future interpolation.
F2: F0 plus five prefix event/distance descriptors: sustained observed brake-phase count (>=5% for >=0.2 s already observed), observed duration below 80 km/h, observed severe-slow duration below 40 km/h, speed recovery since most recent below-80 sample (0 while still low or no low segment), observed path-distance integral of ground speed /3.6 over actual valid positive source intervals. This last quantity is a distance proxy in metres, not a normalized track position or final-lap fraction.
F3: F0 plus the union of F1 and F2, 25 total features. No other combinations, removals or hyperparameter search.
F4: Omitted: source Car Pos Norm is present and the author paper describes normalized spline position, but exact ACTI export mapping/resampling semantics have not been independently established. Do not assert certified current-position semantics. The independent speed-integral distance proxy is included transparently in F2/F3 without any final distance.
threshold_reasoning: 5% brake matches the existing source/model pedal convention; 0.2 s requires an observed sustained phase rather than a single export sample; 80 km/h (22.2 m/s) describes low-speed corner/recovery behavior relative to this formula-car domain; 40 km/h (11.1 m/s) isolates severe slowing. Fixed physical descriptors, not fitted to test outcomes; no lap is excluded by these thresholds.
F0W: One independent weighting intervention on F0 only. Within each fold compute Q25/Q75 from unique FIT-TRAIN targets; each pace class receives equal total estimator loss weight via n_train_laps/(3*n_class_laps). Each lap's five prefixes receive the same weight; normalize snapshot weights to mean one. Imputer/scaler stay unweighted and fit only fold training. Weights never use fold-validation or historical-test labels. Justification: middle-band loss dominance and observed development slow-tail bias, not a claim that slow laps are absent from training.
baselines: Per-fold constant median of unique fold-training targets. Restricted previous-lap uses permitted fold-training history and supported chronological/capture evidence only, with matched coverage. No validation/test history updates.
metrics: All variants use identical 845 development snapshots. Report OOF pooled and per-fold MAE/RMSE/bias/median/P90/max, recording-macro MAE, checkpoint/lap/block and pace error, predicted-on-actual OLS calibration slope and prediction/target SD ratio. Common reporting pace thresholds are frozen original-v071 TRAIN Q25/Q75 (109.734, 140.04333333333335); these descriptive evaluation thresholds are never feature or weight inputs. Weighting uses its own fold-training quantiles.
selection: A variant is a convincing development improvement only if pooled OOF MAE improves by at least 0.5 s and 5%, recording-macro MAE improves by at least 0.25 s, MAE improves in at least 4 of 5 folds, slow-band MAE does not worsen by more than 0.5 s and absolute slow bias does not worsen by more than 0.5 s. Rank qualifying variants by pooled MAE, macro MAE, RMSE, name. Otherwise retain F0. Report spread/calibration without selecting solely for increased variability. No later search if none qualifies.
examples: Development only: deterministic nearest unique-lap targets to the 10th/50th/90th development percentiles plus the worst F0 OOF lap by mean checkpoint absolute error, deduplicated. Show every variant and every checkpoint for these ordinary/fast/slow/difficult examples; no favorable-case selection.
final_artifacts: Fit each fixed variant on all 169 development laps only after OOF selection. Save as an explicitly experimental, signed bundle under artifacts/barcelona_v072/models with feature/version/protocol/domain/base-corpus/development-population metadata. Reference v071 artifacts remain immutable. Any experimental inference API accepts development sources only and uses the same feature builder as training.
UI: Reference SVR remains production. Add optional development-only diagnostics and experimental identity; never silently replace reference or score a variant on the historical test. Preserve hidden-target reference replay and shared hover.
uncertainty: Five folds overlap in training, lap prefixes correlate and block independence is imperfect; report variation descriptively, not significance or a fresh independent final-test result. No deep learning, new dataset acquisition or live recording in this release.
